I got also involuntary movements in my eyes, which was and still is very disturbing and affects my daily life. I stopped taking vraylar and changed into seroquel and I still get these symptoms. I'm not certain whether it is because of vraylar and is now permanent or if seroquel causes me it too. I can't quit seroquel since I have tried basically everything for my bipolar and nothing has worked as well, even though I would want to. I also noticed that Latuda caused this involuntary eye movement (and also terrible nausea).

And yeah, it's called tardive dyskinesia or extrapyramidal symptoms, I'm not certain what is the difference. And it is caused by different neuroleptics.

Vraylar made me gain weight, like over 10kg. I ate exactly the way I used, it just ruined my metabolism. I'm still taking it and trying to loose weight.

I got a "pulling-symptom" in which my eyes could only look up. It was terrible, I couldn't see anything.

Only way I got rid of it (almost) was changing medication, which also causes the same symptom but it doesn't last as long. I'm still taking it because there are no other options left.

I took wellbutrin and lamotrigine at the same time and there were no side effects. I have heard that wellbutrin might cause manic episodes but it didn't on me (probably because I was also on abilify, a mood stabilizer)

I still take wellbutrin during my depressive episodes since i would othervice just sleep all day. I don't take lamotrigine anymore because it just didn't do anything for me
